verdict: Paid spend is generating sales, but purchase cost is high and add-to-cart drop-off is severe.
diagnosis: You spent $2,166 this period and got 562 purchases worth $11,972 — solid return, but only 63 came through your pixel.

signals.headline: 562 purchases from $2,166 spend
signals.detail: Return on ad spend looks strong at roughly 5.5x, driven by the Muslim Subscription Box campaign.

signals.headline: 237 add-to-carts, only 94 checkouts
signals.detail: Roughly 60% of shoppers who add to cart never start checkout. Friction on the cart page is costing sales.

signals.headline: 1,257 link clicks, 1,660 landing views
signals.detail: Landing page views exceed link clicks, suggesting healthy page load and no major tracking gap on entry.

signals.headline: 6,654 followers, 357 profile visits
signals.detail: Organic Instagram reach is small relative to paid. The brand is not yet compounding attention outside ads.

signals.headline: 272 reviews at 5-star average
signals.detail: Google Business Profile reputation is a real asset. Trust signals are stronger than most category peers.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.subheader: Food and beverage customer cost runs $45–$53
benchmark.body: DTC food and beverage acquisition costs average $45 to $53, the lowest of any DTC vertical. Your blended cost per purchase this period sits near $4, well below category norms.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.subheader: Late-summer grilling demand cooling into fall
seasonal.body: August closes peak grilling season. Meat delivery searches typically soften before rebounding for holiday roasts in November. Expect softer top-of-funnel demand over the next six weeks.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.subheader: ButcherBox, Crowd Cow, Porter Road dominate
competitor.body: ButcherBox leads the category at an estimated $750M in 2025 revenue. Crowd Cow and Porter Road compete on farm transparency and specialty cuts — a lane where your American-raised story can win.

recommendations.title: Fix the cart-to-checkout drop-off
recommendations.detail: Only 94 of 237 add-to-carts started checkout this period. Test a simpler cart page, guest checkout, and a shipping cost preview before checkout.

recommendations.title: Lean into farm-story content on Instagram
recommendations.detail: Competitors like Crowd Cow win on transparency. Consider testing short videos on sourcing, ranchers, and cuts to lift organic engagement beyond 37 per post.

recommendations.title: Build a holiday roast campaign for November
recommendations.detail: Grilling demand fades in September. Worth exploring a Thanksgiving and Christmas roast bundle now to capture the next seasonal peak.
